summary: Rewrite toolbar lets a person click a sentence in a document and get a small toolbar with rewrite options, such as Clearer, Shorter or Friendlier. The agent's new sentence is written in word by word next to the struck-out original, and the person accepts it or puts the old one back.
use: When people edit copy with an agent and want to change one sentence without regenerating the whole text.
When the old and new wording should be visible side by side before anything is saved.
When you want a few one-click rewrite styles plus a way to open a fuller agent prompt.
When a shortcut or command menu should be able to trigger the same rewrites.
features: The text is passed as `sentences`, one string each, so a click selects exactly one sentence. The toolbar appears above it, or below it when there is no room above.
`actions` sets the buttons, Clearer, Shorter and Friendlier by default. Each one calls `onRewrite` with the sentence, the action key and its index.
While `onRewrite` works the toolbar says Rewriting. The answer is then typed in word by word, and the toolbar offers Accept and Undo.
Accept saves the sentence and calls `onSentencesChange` with the full text. Undo, or a failed `onRewrite`, leaves the original sentence as it was.
The wand button calls `onAsk` if you pass it, or runs the first action. Its tooltip shows `askLabel` and the `askShortcut` hint.
A ref exposes `rewrite(action)`, `accept()` and `undo()` so you can drive it from your own shortcuts or scripts.
a11y: The toolbar has `role="toolbar"` with `aria-label="Rewrite"`, and it is `inert` while no sentence is selected.
The wand button has an `aria-label` taken from `askLabel`.
With reduced motion turned on, the rewrite appears all at once instead of word by word.

faq.q: How do I connect it to my model?
faq.a: Pass `onRewrite(sentence, action, index)` and return the new sentence or a promise of it. The component handles the waiting state, the word-by-word reveal and the review step.

faq.q: What happens if the rewrite request fails?
faq.a: If `onRewrite` throws or rejects, the sentence stays as it was and the toolbar goes back to offering the rewrite actions.

faq.q: Does the ⌘K shortcut work out of the box?
faq.a: No. `askShortcut` is only shown in the wand's tooltip. Bind the key yourself and call the ref's `rewrite` method or your own `onAsk` logic.

faq.q: Can I click away while the agent is still rewriting?
faq.a: A click outside closes the toolbar only when no rewrite is in progress. While a rewrite is waiting, the toolbar stays open until it is accepted or undone.
